name: unet-sdk
description: Canonical Sovereign Core V2 SDK, documentation, and examples for U-net.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run contracts:generate && tsc -b packages/contracts packages/client packages/web-login packages/verification packages/issuer packages/server packages/setup packages/react compat/contracts compat/client compat/web-login compat/verification compat/issuer compat/server compat/setup compat/react examples/react-login examples/react-age-check examples/checkout-bound-verification && node scripts/copy-contracts.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/client packages/web-login packages/verification packages/issuer packages/server packages/setup packages/react compat/contracts compat/client compat/web-login compat/verification compat/issuer compat/server compat/setup compat/react examples/react-login examples/react-age-check examples/checkout-bound-verification --pretty false
scripts.docs:build: pnpm run build && pnpm docs:api && node scripts/build-docs.mjs
